Acuver Consulting is seeking a highly energetic IBM Sterling OMS Senior Consultant with 5 to 8 years of relevant experience. **Company Description:**
InfoBeans is an AI-first software development and implementation company that helps enterprise clients solve complex business challenges through innovative technology solutions.
  
  
Listed on the NSE in India, the organization has a global presence across the US, Europe, and the Middle East.

"Creating WOW!" reflects its commitment to delivering exceptional value and experiences to clients and team members alike.
  
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site ServiceNow ITOM and ITAM Developer role based in Pune City.
  
  
The role involves designing, configuring, and implementing ServiceNow IT Operations Management (ITOM) and IT Asset Management (ITAM) modules, including discovery, service mapping, CMDB, and asset lifecycle processes.
  
  
The developer will collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, optimize workflows, integrate ServiceNow with other enterprise systems, and ensure data quality and compliance with governance standards.
  
  
Daily responsibilities include building and maintaining scripts, business rules, and integrations, troubleshooting platform issues, and contributing to best practices and documentation.
  
  
The person in this role also supports performance tuning, participates in code reviews, and helps drive continuous improvement of the ServiceNow Strong hands-on experience with ServiceNow ITOM modules (Discovery, CMDB, Service Mapping, Event Management) and ITAM processes (hardware and software asset management).
  
  

* Proficiency in ServiceNow configuration and development, including scripting (JavaScript), workflows, business rules, UI policies, and custom applications.
* Knowledge of infrastructure, networks, cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), and integration methods (REST, SOAP, APIs) relevant to enterprise environments.
* Understanding of ITIL/ITSM processes, asset lifecycle management, and governance, with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Experience with performance tuning, debugging, and troubleshooting within ServiceNow, plus familiarity with security, compliance, and data quality practices.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* ServiceNow certifications in ITOM, ITAM, or related areas are highly beneficial.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work in cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities on-site in Pune City.
